risks: Scanner-only member delta is incompatible with functional r11; additional bootstrap member deltas need explicit approval.
Pointer containing manifest SHA while manifest includes pointer SHA creates a digest cycle; keep pointer path/revision-only and bind raw manifest SHA downstream.
Import-time adapter identity may be cached in a long-lived process; require a fresh process for approved r11 audit and no fallback.
Existing r10 authorization is historically unconsumed but its formal command was invoked and is non-reusable; retirement requires a separate frozen-contract determination.
A new builder or pointer left outside the r11 20-member inventory weakens construction lineage.
rollback: Before publishing a freeze, abandon only new drafts without changing history. After publication, never edit/delete r11; fail closed and supersede with a separately approved later revision. If authorization has issued, use frozen lifecycle rules rather than resetting state.
